status: prospectively frozen before name or matched-replay outcomes
hypothesis: Some score changes between semantic-name reruns and archived original prompts may reflect batch/layout changes. A contemporaneous matched-cohort original-prompt replay separates that nuisance from the Plan1/Plan2 textual rename in this fixed model and cohort.
selection: Exactly the same 1248 selected original prompts from the 12 prespecified worlds used by semantic_names_v1, in the same row order and 39 contiguous batches of 32. Preserve all model, seed, sampling, capture and generation settings. No outcome-based selection.
original_estimand_preserved: The original frozen name-versus-archived analysis and source models remain unchanged. This is a named supplementary paired control, not a replacement endpoint.
secondary_contrasts: matched original replay minus archived original
renamed minus archived original for cross-check only
predictors: All original source coefficients, scaling, orientations and thresholds unchanged. Primary final28 direct observed-violation and permission-gated physical-semantic heads. Final26/30 sensitivity only. No early instrument, refitting, recalibration or head/layer selection.
outcomes: Actual selected physical designated operation and actual permission violation reconstructed from strict valid A/B responses; the physical operation-to-code mapping remains fixed. Literal Plan2-to-code mapping flips only in renamed prompts. Failed/invalid responses remain in assigned counts; paired behavioral means use jointly valid rows and disclose their denominator plus worst-case bounds.
paired_analysis: Report assigned/valid-pair counts, actual semantic-action and violation differences, action disagreement counts, continuous score differences and frozen-threshold flips. Equal-world paired means with 2000 world-bootstrap resamples over all 12 selected worlds; per-family only three worlds and explicitly descriptive. Report score differences on all pairs and, separately, unchanged-action versus changed-action pairs as descriptive conditioning. No independent-row intervals.
specificity: For each collection, report restricted positive/negative decision and world support, primary AUROC/operating point and within-presentation/utility/mapping/display-order mixed-class support counts. Absent or sparse within-cue support does not identify behavioral specificity. Authorized false alarms remain separate. Semantic versus literal-name targets retain the earlier amendment.
layout_audit: Independently verify exact original versus renamed prompt substitution, 39 cohort memberships, row position, rendered token lengths and padded widths. Preserve any discrepancy and qualify causal attribution. Same padded layout plus deterministic repeat stability supports a bounded textual-manipulation interpretation, not a general numerical robustness claim.
scope: 12 reused worlds, original descriptor duplication and reliability single-structure limits retained. No fresh family discovery, broad monitor qualification or causal-regulator claim.
execution: Exp6 owns root-approved collection; Exp2 performs only fixed-source CPU projections. No launch until request freeze, independent preflight and root release.
